descriptions.w3d_d30e_load_sample_801dd0e8: Creates a sound sample object from a description: loads a .wav or .vag file by extension, or copies an already registered sample found by name when it reports ready; applies the description's fields through virtual slots 9 and 11 and setters at 0x801df1dc to 0x801df280, then appends it to the manager. Returns 0 or 0x80004005. Reference counted through a one-word holder. Names are inferred.
